translations.web: They will come from the east, west, north, and south, and will sit down in God’s Kingdom.
translations.bsb: People will come from east and west and north and south, and will recline at the table in the kingdom of God.
translations.kjv: And they shall come from the east, and from the west, and from the north, and from the south, and shall sit down in the kingdom of God.
translations.asv: And they shall come from the east and west, and from the north and south, and shall sit down in the kingdom of God.
